candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Initial passive or activist stake disclosure could identify under-owned leaders with informed sponsorship.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: SEC submissions expose recent forms but not a parsed accession-level 13G/13D holder/stake event surface across the three canonical windows. Raw 13G/13D event retries are already frozen.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: A parsed PIT 13G/13D event table with holder, stake, action type, issuer ticker, and accession date.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Accelerated filer upgrades or emerging-growth exits could mark liquidity and disclosure-quality inflections.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: The submissions cache contains current top-level category metadata. Using it for historical 2024-2026 windows would leak future filer status.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: Historical cover-page filer status parsed from each 10-K/10-Q accession and joined to the same date seen by production.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Specific SEC text events can be mispriced when price absorbs the event slowly.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: The recent sequence of 8-K item/text scouts failed. The aggregate three-window SEC text file is 8-K only, so moving to 10-K/10-Q text would change the data surface without a fixed measurement base.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: A materially new structured event tuple or LLM-labeled event field, not another item-code or regex gate.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Options skew and open interest could identify informed demand ahead of equity continuation.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: Options snapshots are recent forward rows and do not cover the old_thin standard window. Positive forward rows would be leads, not an accepted Gate-4 alpha.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: Historical PIT options chain snapshots covering all three standard windows, plus shared daily snapshot semantics.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Borrow-fee relief or short-interest covering could improve candidate selection around crowded winners.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: FINRA short-interest rows exist, but the non-duplicate edge would require borrow-fee or rebate history. That field is not available in the repository.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: Free or stored PIT borrow-fee/rebate data joined to FINRA short interest across the standard windows.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: A less-explored fundamentals ratio might improve the candidate pool after advertising efficiency failed.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: The novelty gate classified this reservation as a Companyfacts near-neighbor. Recent Companyfacts runs mostly failed or are already accepted helpers; another tag/threshold sweep would be a multiple-testing retry, not a new edge.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: A genuinely new free fundamentals data source or a structured field not covered by prior Companyfacts ratio families.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Low float or scarce supply could increase squeeze-like upside for leaders.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: The recent public-float scout improved EV modestly but failed coverage and concentration standards. Retuning float thresholds would not add a new evidence axis.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: A broader PIT float/history source or a separate supply-demand field that fixes old_thin coverage and concentration.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Peer leadership or laggard catch-up could expand the candidate pool without paid data.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: The latest lead-lag direction-stability experiment did not establish a robust direction. Repeating static OHLCV peer gates risks fitting the same windows.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: External PIT peer relationship evidence or a production-visible event trigger that explains the lead-lag direction.

candidate_surfaces.alpha_hypothesis: Institutional sponsorship changes could identify durable leaders or under-owned winners.
candidate_surfaces.why_not_executable_now: The current Kova 13F surface exposes daily status rows, not a new three-window manager-holder delta table. Prior 13F sponsorship/crowding attempts already cover the obvious shapes.
candidate_surfaces.new_evidence_needed: A PIT 13F holding-delta table with manager identity, filing date, value/share changes, and closed outcomes.
